description: CodebookAI is a desktop application designed for AI-assisted qualitative data analysis, leveraging the OpenAI API to manage task-centric workflows, model discovery, secure credential storage, and statistical validation of AI-generated labels.

components.name: Task Configuration & Model Registry
components.description: Manages the discovery, caching, and selection of available AI models alongside the UI components for building and configuring structured analysis tasks.

components.name: Model Registry & UI Layout Manager
components.description: Manages the lifecycle of AI model metadata, including fetching from APIs, disk caching, and preloading during application startup. It also provides the structural UI containers used to organize the task configuration interface.

components.name: Task Logic & Execution Controller
components.description: Orchestrates the core logic of task creation, including prompt engineering with dynamic placeholders, output field collection, and the triggering of live or batch processing runs.

components.name: Data Input & Field Mapping UI
components.description: Handles the ingestion of source data files and the interactive UI elements for field selection, managing column mapping and real-time data previews.

components.name: Configuration & Secrets Management
components.description: Handles persistent user preferences, application settings, and the secure storage of API credentials required for LLM provider interactions.
